newsitem.title: USA: Cato sets Q4 store closings charge.
newsitem.headline: Cato sets Q4 store closings charge.

text.p: Cato Corp said Thursday it will take an estimated pretax charge of $5.5 million related to the closing of 37 stores during the fourth quarter.
The after-tax effect on earnings will be about $3.5 million, or $0.12 a share, it said.

"These stores represent approximately five ercent of our existing stores and are currently unprofitable. Our store development plan for 1997 calls for opening new downsized stores in order to replace this square footage with productive units. We also expect to relocate 12 to 15 existing stores on an opportunistic basis to keep our real estate healthy," Cato said.
The company said it will release the results for the fourth quarter on March 18.
